by
  let f := fun n => Real.exp (-↑r) * ↑r ^ n / ↑n.factorial
  let s := ∑' f
  have h : ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N, ∀ n ≥ N, |∑_{k=0}^n f k - 1| < ε
  { intro ε,
    cases (Real.exists_pos_real ε) with δ hδ,
    let N := Nat.ceiling (Real.log (δ / Real.exp (-↑r)) / log_real ↑r)
    refine ⟨N, _⟩
    intros n hn,
    have h1 : ∑_{k=0}^n f k = Real.exp (-↑r) * ∑_{k=0}^n ↑r^k / ↑k.factorial
    { rw sum_const_mul },
    have h2 : ∑_{k=0}^n ↑r^k / ↑k.factorial ≤ Real.exp ↑r
    { apply Real.exp_sum_le },
    have h3 : |∑_{k=0}^n f k - 1| = |Real.exp (-↑r) * (∑_{k=0}^n ↑r^k / ↑k.factorial - Real.exp ↑r)| 
    { rw abs_mul, rw abs_sub, rw abs_of_nonneg (Real.exp_nonneg _), simp },
    have h4 : |∑_{k=0}^n f k - 1| ≤ Real.exp (-↑r) * |∑_{k=0}^n ↑r^k / ↑k.factorial - Real.exp ↑r|
    { rw abs_mul, rw abs_sub, rw abs_of_nonneg (Real.exp_nonneg _), simp },
    have h5 : |∑_{k=0}^n ↑r^k / ↑k.factorial - Real.exp ↑r| < δ
    { apply Real.exp_sum_converges_lt, exact hn },
    calc |∑_{k=0}^n f k - 1| ≤ Real.exp (-↑r) * δ
    ... < Real.exp (-↑r) * (δ / Real.exp (-↑r)) 
    ... = Real.exp (-↑r) * δ / Real.exp (-↑r)
    ... = δ
    ... < ε
    by rw [h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, mul_div_assoc, mul_self_eq_pow, pow_one, div_self, mul_one] }
  exact HasSum.of_cauchy s h
